inline_prompts: You are given a positive integer N and an integer sequence A = (A_1,A_2,\dots,A_N) of length N. Determine whether there exists a non-empty (contiguous) subarray of A that has a repeated value. If such a subarray exists, find the length of the shortest such subarray. If no subarray contains a repeated value, what should be printed? Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: N A_1 A_2 \dots A_N Output print the length of the shortest such subarray. Constraints - 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5 - 1 \leq A_i \leq 10^6 \ (1 \leq i \leq N) - All input values are integers.
